fresh_corpus_contract.source_relationship: fresh generation from frozen v2.2 streams; no states, g values, sample IDs, or artifacts copied from calibration pool

freshness: inherited unchanged from Protocol v2.1: exact identity/reuse only; projective proximity is separate

blocked_g.interval_construction: existing Protocol v2.1 blocked-g rule: remove two 0.02 gaps and allocate remaining interval lengths by 0.70/0.15/0.15 in train,val,test order
blocked_g.parameter_sampling: for class 0 then 1 and train,val,test order, draw fixed split counts uniformly within the corresponding blocked interval using confirmatory.blocked_g.parameter_generation PCG64DXSM stream
blocked_g.split_assignment: determined by sampled interval; no split RNG

generation_determinism.blocked_split_stream: none; interval and declared sample order determine split
generation_determinism.constrained_retry_stream: for attempt starting at 0, derive retry_seed=SeedSequence([frozen random split seed, attempt]).generate_state(1,uint64)[0], instantiate one PCG64DXSM Generator, then execute the SHA-256-anchored v2.1 candidate/preference ordering; discard generator on failure; accept first feasible attempt; maximum 32 retries after attempt 0
generation_determinism.degeneracy_replacement: accept when E1-E0 > 1e-10; otherwise draw replacement uniformly from the same class and same regime/split interval using that regime replacement_sampling PCG64DXSM stream; at most 100 replacements per rejected sample; preserve sample position and ID; exhaustion blocks generation
generation_determinism.parameter_stream_consumption: consume only the fixed initial uniform arrays in declared class/split/sample order; degeneracy replacements never consume parameter-generation streams

random.constrained_assignment: exact Protocol v2.1 algorithm and epsilon_sep; retry seeds SeedSequence([frozen random split seed, attempt]); first feasible attempt only
random.parameter_sampling: for class 0 then 1, draw 200 uniform g values from the class closed contract interval using confirmatory.random.parameter_generation PCG64DXSM stream
random.preferred_unconstrained_assignment: for class 0 then 1, class-stratified permutation using frozen random split seed PCG64DXSM and assign first 140 train, next 30 val, final 30 test

generation_determinism.random_preference_stream: instantiate one PCG64DXSM Generator from frozen random split seed; shuffle class-0 indices once then class-1 indices once using Generator.shuffle; no other draws from this generator
generation_determinism.replacement_exhaustion: after 100 rejected replacement draws for one sample, stop with DEGENERACY_REPLACEMENT_EXHAUSTED; no restart and no alternate seed
generation_determinism.replacement_stream_consumption: instantiate once per regime; consume one scalar uniform draw only for each rejected state, immediately in sample order, from the rejected sample same interval; accepted states consume no replacement draw
generation_determinism.sample_order: class 0 then class 1; within random, original parameter draw order; within blocked-g, train then val then test and draw order
generation_determinism.stream_initialization: instantiate exactly one fresh PCG64DXSM Generator per materialized generation domain at corpus-generation start; never share generators across domains or regimes
generation_determinism.uniform_api: numpy.Generator.uniform(low, high, size), float64, half-open [low, high)

generation_seed_contract.root_rationale: existing frozen root whose named dataset.split domain materializes the v2.1 random split seed

scientific_contract: all Protocol v2.1 scientific, FS, split, freshness, QCNN, and statistical rules inherited unchanged
